notes.title: Xbox Gamepad Support!
notes.content:
This release adds full gamepad support, ensuring that all prompts, menus, and gameplay in [b]Swashbuckler's Xmas[/b] work on both Xbox controllers as well as keyboard/mouse. We're really excited about this release, since it will make it a lot easier for kids and anyone who prefers gamepad to enjoy Captain Smokey's adventure.

[h1]Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Use input action icons in help text
[*] Don't select targets that are not in the field of view
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fix alignment issue on main menu for some resolutions
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Dec 27, 2025
notes.content:
This patch contains a few small enhancements and a number of bug fixes.

[h2]Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Catapults have much better aim now
[*] Improved hockey mode camera
[*] Added ambient sound to main menu
[*] Added UI sounds
[*] Slightly improved gamepad button styles
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed timing and UI issues with narrator dialogue in ending cinematic
[*] Fixed random skating noises in Elfton
[*] Fixed an issue where the Dopplegangers would skate off the map
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content: This patch includes a fix for an issue where the player could fall through the top of the mountain.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:

notes.title: Update #1: Catapults, more enemies, and bug fixes
notes.content:
Ahoy! This first update includes some more and different enemies to handle in Elfton as well as a few bug fixes.

[h2]Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added catapults to Elfton
[*] Added more elves to Elfton
[*] Improved enemy AI
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed enemies appearing out of thin air
[*] Fixed continue game flow
[/list]

notes.title: Swashbuckler's Xmas is available NOW!
notes.content:
North Shore Games is proud to present its first release: [b]Swashbuckler's Xmas[/b]! Download via Steam in the next two weeks and enjoy a [u]40% launch discount[/u]. 

[h2]Note about Early Access[/h2]

[b]Swashbuckler's Xmas [/b] really SHOULD be in Early Access, since we have not completed all the levels we have planned and have surely missed a "few" bugs. However, we will not be participating in Early Access, because we launched our game before we had signed up for the program (d'oh!). We were unaware that a game can't be retroactively added to Early Access after release, and we were just so excited to get our game out before Christmas! We'll update the store page with the current development status and roadmap in the next few days. 

Please enjoy this first release and stay tuned for more updates soon!

notes.title: Yar! Thank you, Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[b]Ahoy, mateys![/b]

Thanks for checking out [b]Swashbuckler's Xmas[/b] during the October 2024 Steam Next Fest! The demo will be up for a bit after the festival ends, so if you have not played it yet, you've still got some time. This demo may be your only chance to see a Pirate shooting like a rocket out of a chimney today, so what are you waiting for?!

We'll be quite busy for the next few months adding a lot more polish, levels and features to the game, so please look out for announcements like this one to keep up-to-date!

Also, please check out the Next Fest demo for our other game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1899000/Sidewards/]Sidewards[/url]. It's a chill stone-skipping simulator you can play with your friends. Thanks!
